reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept Format 1 MOVE {identifier-1 | literal-1} TO identifier-2 ... (one sending operand, which may be a figurative constant, ALL literal, reference-modified or subscripted identifier, or, under the intrinsic-function amendment, a function-identifier; one or more receiving identifiers) and Format 2 MOVE {CORRESPONDING | CORR} identifier-1 TO identifier-2 (exactly one receiver), and refuse every shape neither format prints, plus later-edition operand forms (hex, national literals, inline method invocation); the witness covers the format-shape refusals at the 2023 framing.

edition-consulted.switches: hex alphanumeric literal X".." and national literal N".." (Constructs.HexAlphanumericLiteral2002 / NationalLiteral2002): COBOL0900 below 2002
empty function argument list only (2002); a function-identifier sender itself is admitted at 85

reader.edition-search: grep Edition/CobolVersion/Constructs in MoveBinder.cs (only diagnostic sinks via ctx.Edition, no edition comparison); moveStatement/moveReceivingPhrase/sendingOperand carry no edition predicate; the gates are operand-level in LiteralScreen and VersionConformancePass.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 the sending-operand alternatives hex/national literal and inline method invocation are refused (COBOL0900); the two format shapes are parsed and bound by the same edition-free rules as at 2023.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pins the format shapes; the 85-only refusals of later operand forms and the multi-receiver/refmod/CORR run behaviour are not exercised by it

probes.expected: multiple receivers with and without comma, literal, ALL literal, figurative ZERO/QUOTES, signed scaled to numeric-edited, refmod sender/receivers with a variable length, CORRESPONDING and CORR, function sender, receivers evaluated immediately before each move (GR2: TE(L) with L=1 before L is changed)
A(2:L) with L=3 is ELL; TE(3)=E; B(4:) receives EL

reader.notes: Both 1985 formats are spelled by one edition-free grammar rule and MoveBinder.Bind; every shape outside them is refused at parse time with a named diagnostic, and the post-1985 sending-operand forms are refused at 85 by operand-level construct gates. Run results of every arm, including CORR and GR2's per-receiver evaluation, match the text.
